results.question: Explain AWS Savings Plans
results.answer:
AWS Savings Plans are a flexible pricing model that provides lower prices on your AWS compute workloads in exchange for a commitment to use a specified amount of compute power over a one or three year period, according to the document "What are Savings Plans".

* Compute Savings Plans offer lower prices on Amazon EC2 instance usage regardless of instance family, size, OS, tenancy, or Region, and also apply to AWS Fargate and AWS Lambda usage, as stated in "What are Savings Plans".
* SageMaker AI Savings Plans provide lower prices for Amazon SageMaker AI instance usage regardless of instance family, size, component, or Region, as described in "What are Savings Plans".
* You can manage your plans, view recommendations, and purchase plans using AWS Cost Explorer, as noted in "What are Savings Plans".
* Payment options include All upfront, Partial upfront, or No upfront, according to "What are Savings Plans".
